تمتعضين (form VIII)
# تَمْتَعِضِينَ (tamtaʕiḍīna) /tam.ta.ʕi.dˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# تُمْتَعَضِينَ (tumtaʕaḍīna) /tum.ta.ʕa.dˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
